source_lines: 症狀開始前是否發生過外傷或感染

review_notes.note: 若患者回報「呼吸困難、喘鳴」或「臉部、脖子或喉嚨有腫脹」，可能表示呼吸道受阻的風險，應優先評估。RAG 文獻提到呼吸窘迫 (respiratory distress) 是兒童咽後膿瘍 (retropharyngeal abscess) 的徵兆之一。
若患者回報「吞嚥困難」合併「喉嚨痛」，應考慮扁桃腺周圍膿瘍 (peritonsillar abscess) 的可能性，此為 RAG 文獻中提到的警訊症狀。

rag_sources.title: Trichinosis (Trichinellosis): Background, Pathophysiology, Epidemiology
rag_sources.excerpt: Those with mild symptoms improve in 2-3 weeks. Symptoms associated with heavy infections may persist for 2-3 months. Factors that may affect morbidity include the quantity of larvae ingested, the species of Trichinella (most notably T spiralis), and the immune status of the host. Patients succumb to exhaustion, pneumonia, pulmonary embolism, encephalitis, or cardiac failure and/or arrhythmia. Death from trichinosis usually occurs in 4-8 weeks but may occur as early as in 2-3 weeks.
